title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Shisha Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Shisha Edition Pre Filled Pods bring two richly layered flavours to the Elf Bar Dual 10K experience. One pod features Grape Mint, a bold grape blend laced with a gentle minty lift. The second pod delivers Fruits 66, a shisha-style fruit medley with dark, sweet undertones and subtle spiced warmth. Each 2ml pod is paired with a 5ml refill chamber, automatically replenished by the Dual 10K internal system for uninterrupted use. If you're after depth, character and a hint of shisha-style richness, Shisha Edition offers a flavour pairing with real flair. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
